notes: Ports come from the model.mil graph: fp16 inputs a and b, output y, all [1, 1, 128, 128]. Bar slots, buffer ids, channels and strides are absent on purpose. The repo port reader parses H14 program-descriptor HWX files only, and this legacy thread-state HWX has no reader yet. Read the numbers from the file before a driver uses them; do not copy them from another chip.
